qualification: Fresh Node independent replay with unchanged exact courses. Real approaches and quantized pulse commands; successful completion with zero contacts. Shield loss is accepted and explicitly reported. Browser presentation and final packaged offline qualification are separate.
alignmentDefinition: Consecutive20ms replay positions at horizontal speed>=1000mm/s versus drone yaw; forward<=90deg, aligned<=45deg.

reproduction.result: All sixteen complete course+proof artifact SHA256 hashes exactly reproduced by the installed repository-relative generator in a fresh Node process.

origin: Original locally authored offline proportional/derivative command recorder; no third-party source or runtime autopilot.
runtimeModuleHashScope: Snapshot at container yard batch preparation. Later batches append records; per-proof hashes remain independently verifiable.

pilotingChoices.approach: Physically approach authored target-specific anchors before aiming and firing quantized pulse commands. All actual projectiles and opponent fire remain active. Successful examples can lose shields; health and damage observations are retained.
pilotingChoices.hazards: Return at 6.2 m above moving hazard lanes; extraction uses a recorded detour before the original landing pad.
pilotingChoices.limits: Command-only piloting. No course, actor, collision, scoring or runtime changes. Browser presentation and offline qualification are reported separately.

browserVerification.coverage: 104 recorded examples cover all 52 Academy, Woodland Park, Ukrainian Courtyard, Warehouse, Racing Stadium and Container Yard challenges in both modes. Parking Garage examples are still in production.

mobile.coverage: 104 записані приклади охоплюють усі 52 завдання Академії, Лісопарку, Українського подвір’я, Складу, Перегонового стадіону та Контейнерного двору в обох режимах. Приклади для Паркінгу ще готуються.
